title: The full cotangent complex of a localization vanishes
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $S\subseteq R$ a multiplicative subset, meaning $1\in S$ and $s,t\in S$ imply $st\in S$. Let $S^{-1}R$ be the ring of fractions $r/s$, with its canonical map $R\to S^{-1}R$. Then the standard cotangent complex $L_{S^{-1}R/R}$ of [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence] is a zero object in $D(S^{-1}R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; equivalently, $H^i(L_{S^{-1}R/R})=0$ for every integer $i$. No finite generation of $S$ and no finite presentation of $S^{-1}R$ over $R$ are assumed, and $0\in S$ is allowed.
